fields.name: actualCloseDate
fields.label: Actual Execution Date
fields.hint: Fill only once fully executed.
fields.description: Use this field to specify the actual close date.

fields.name: assignedDate
fields.label: Assigned Date
fields.description: Use this field to specify an assigned date.

fields.name: branchCode
fields.label: Pursuit Source
fields.hint: Inbound = they came to us. Outbound = cold BD. Referral = third-party warm intro. Event = met at conference. Executive network = warm intro from exec relationship. Reactivation = prior lead or client rekindled.

fields.name: clientContact
fields.label: Primary Contact
fields.hint: Day-to-day client contact driving the MSA. Required.

fields.name: clientCorporation
fields.label: Client Company
fields.hint: The client legal entity that will sign. Create the Company record first if missing.

fields.name: committed
fields.label: Pursuit Source
fields.hint: How this MSA entered pipeline. Pick one: Inbound, Outbound, Referral, Event / conference, Executive network, Reactivation.

fields.name: customDate1
fields.label: MSA Effective Date
fields.hint: Effective date on the signed MSA. Not necessarily the execution date.

fields.name: customDate2
fields.label: MSA Expiration Date
fields.hint: Expiration date on the signed MSA. Trigger to start renewal work.

fields.name: customDate3
fields.label: NDA Signed Date
fields.hint: Date of the governing NDA if signed before the MSA.

fields.name: customInt1
fields.label: Term Length (Months)
fields.hint: Initial term length in months. Example: 24.

fields.name: customInt2
fields.label: Renewal Notice (Days)
fields.hint: Days of notice required to prevent auto-renewal or signal renewal.

fields.name: customText1
fields.label: Next Action
fields.hint: Single next step to advance this MSA and who owns it. Example: Bill to return redlines by 5/1.

fields.name: customText2
fields.label: Auto-Renewal
fields.hint: Yes or No, plus notice period if Yes. Example: Yes, 60 days.

fields.name: customText3
fields.label: Exclusivity
fields.hint: Exclusive, Non-exclusive, or Preferred. Note carve-outs.

fields.name: customText4
fields.label: Rate Card Attached
fields.hint: Yes or No. If Yes, note where the rate card lives.

fields.name: customText5
fields.label: Client Signing Authority
fields.hint: Named individual or title with authority to sign on the client side.

fields.name: customTextBlock1
fields.label: Key Commercial Terms
fields.hint: Bullet list of payment terms, rate structure, indemnity caps, non-standard terms.

fields.name: customTextBlock2
fields.label: Negotiation Notes
fields.hint: Running log of negotiation moves and verbal agreements. Date-stamp entries.

fields.name: description
fields.label: MSA Scope / Notes
fields.hint: One paragraph summary of services covered and any scope carve-outs.

fields.name: estimatedDuration
fields.label: Estimated Duration
fields.description: If left blank, this field will default to 2.

fields.name: expectedBillRate
fields.label: Expected Bill Rate
fields.description: Use this field to specify an expected weekly spread.

fields.name: expectedCloseDate
fields.label: Target Execution Date
fields.hint: Date we are targeting for full execution. Update as it slips.

fields.name: expectedFee
fields.label: Expected Perm Fee %
fields.description: Use this field specify an expected fee.

fields.name: lead
fields.label: Originating Lead
fields.hint: Anura person who sourced this relationship.

fields.name: owner
fields.label: MSA Owner (Internal)
fields.hint: Anura internal user driving this MSA to execution.

fields.name: priority
fields.label: MSA Priority
fields.hint: High, Medium, or Low. Reflect commercial value and likelihood.

fields.name: reasonClosed
fields.label: Close Reason
fields.hint: Required when Status = Closed. Why it did not execute.

fields.name: reportToClientContact
fields.label: Client Signer
fields.hint: Client executive with signing authority. Leave blank if unknown.

fields.name: source
fields.label: Pursuit Source
fields.hint: Select how this MSA pursuit originated

fields.name: status
fields.label: Status
fields.hint: Identified = logged, not active yet. Qualifying = discovery. Negotiating = terms in flight. Legal Review = with legal counsel. Executed = signed. Burner = parking. Closed = dead or superseded.

fields.name: title
fields.label: MSA Name
fields.hint: Use format: [Client Company] MSA [YYYY]. Example: Jefferson Health MSA 2026.

fields.name: type
fields.label: MSA Type
fields.hint: New = net-new client. Amendment = change to executed MSA. Renewal = replacing expired or expiring MSA.

fields.name: weightedDealValue
fields.label: Weighted Deal Value
fields.hint: Do not enter a value here.
fields.description: Do not enter a value here.
